title: Treatise of the Three Azure Points
summary: Teaches a Xiantian student to drive three needles of qi from the tines and to plunge the fork through a guard.

title: Twin-Court Trident Canon
summary: A canon of matched exchanges in which each thrust is answered by its twin and returned.

title: Dual-Track Trident Canon
summary: Teaches fighting on two tracks at once with the outer tines and crossing between them in a flash.

title: The Hawk Above the Basin: A Trident Canon
summary: A canon of high stooping dives and low catching guards drawn from the hawk above the basin.

title: Paired Currents of the Trident Master
summary: Teaches a master to run paired currents of qi along the outer tines and to seal a weapon in the fork.

title: Monarch's Paired Fork Discipline
summary: A rare discipline for Monarchs that drives the whole meridian net through a paired fork.

title: The Wind Oath of the Trident
summary: Teaches a sworn line of thrust that holds against the wind and every blow struck upon the haft.

title: Plateau-Edge Trident Canon
summary: A canon of fighting at the edge of a plateau with rooted feet and the drop at the opponent's back.

title: Treatise of the Fork Without Walls
summary: Teaches guarding the whole stance with rings of qi on open ground where no wall stands.

title: The Long Bearing: A Trident Canon
summary: A canon of holding one bearing on the opponent through every shift until the fork reaches the body.

title: The Oath-Sworn Fork Canon
summary: Binds the wielder to each stroke by oath and teaches the fork-hold that nullifies a charged thrust.

title: Monarch's Wind-Bearing Fork Discipline
summary: A rare Monarch discipline that gathers the gale behind the fork along one held bearing.
